name: STOVKAHRA
description: Stovkahra (Slovak: 'Hundred Game' or 'Hundreth') is a trick-taking card game for 4 players in fixed partnerships. It is played with a 32-card German or French-suited deck (7-Ace). The goal is to reach 100 points first by winning point cards (Ace, Ten, King, Queen, Jack) and melding combinations.

content.text: Stovkahra (Slovak: 'Hundred Game' or 'Hundreth') is a trick-taking card game for 4 players in fixed partnerships. It is played with a 32-card German or French-suited deck (7-Ace). The goal is to reach 100 points first by winning point cards (Ace, Ten, King, Queen, Jack) and melding combinations.

Trappola originated in Venice (Cardano, 1564) and spread to Central Europe, where it developed many variations. Stovkahra (Brčko) is a surviving form played in the Czech village of Šumice in Romania's Banát region. Researched by Tomáš Svoboda in 1997 and published in The Playing-Card; it retains Trappola point values and bonuses using a German 32-card pack after original Trappola cards ceased production in 1944.
German suited 32-card pack (7 to Ace); eight cards each in 3-2-3 packets; bottom card shown for trump.

Deal 8 cards each (4-4 or 3-2-3). Last card turned for Trump.

items.text: Play to 20 brček: When a team reaches 10 brček, continue the series to 20. If the first team to 10 also reaches 20 first they win two series; if the other team reaches 20 first the result is a draw.
